decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed advertisements, due to their compatible scale, appearance and position would be compatible with the commercial appearance of the area, the character of the building, and would not harm the adjoining businesses or result in conditions harmful to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area. The proposal therefore complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.1.4 (Advertisements) and S.4.2 (Shop Front Design) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - The street number of the property shall be displayed on the fascia hereby approved.
Condition : 4 - The illumination of the signs hereby permitted shall be static and shall not be intermittent.

Condition : 5 - Informative 1: 
At the time of this permission the premises does not have consent for a change of use from a shop to a restaurant (see pending planning application reference 00610/65-67/P5).
description: Installation of internally illuminated fascia & projecting signs
